description: Source code for the MtpDevice class handling USB MTP device interactions in Android, including device opening, session management, object handling, and data transfer.

classes.name: MtpDevice
classes.description: Class managing USB MTP device communication, including device initialization, session control, object management, and data transfer.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Static method to open and initialize an MTP device given device name and file descriptor.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device session and retrieves device info and properties.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the device connection and releases resources.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints device info and supported properties.

methods.name: getDeviceName
methods.description: Returns the device name.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens an MTP session with the device.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the current session (placeholder).

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information.

methods.name: getStorageIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of storage IDs.

methods.name: getStorageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific storage.

methods.name: getObjectHandles
methods.description: Gets object handles for a storage, format, and parent.

methods.name: getObjectInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific object.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Gets thumbnail data for an object.

methods.name: sendObjectInfo
methods.description: Sends object information to the device.

methods.name: sendObject
methods.description: Sends object data to the device.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes an object from the device.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Gets parent handle of an object.

methods.name: getStorageID
methods.description: Gets storage ID of an object.

methods.name: getObjectPropsSupported
methods.description: Retrieves supported object properties for a format.

methods.name: getDevicePropDesc
methods.description: Gets device property description.

methods.name: getObjectPropDesc
methods.description: Gets object property description.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Reads object data and processes via callback.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Reads object data and writes to a file.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an MTP operation request.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sends data associated with a request.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads data from the device.

methods.name: writeDataHeader
methods.description: Writes a data header for a transfer.

methods.name: readResponse
methods.description: Reads a response from the device.
